image_description: A lively outdoor scene featuring a traditional May Day celebration. A tall, decorated pole (maypole) stands in the center, adorned with colorful ribbons/streamers extending downwards. Numerous children and adults are holding the ends of these streamers, dancing in a circle around the pole on a grassy field. The background includes trees and spectators.
